title: Open the location search with the "/" keyboard shortcut
body:
Adding a location requires reaching the "Add location" button. Let keyboard users open
  the search from anywhere on the main page by pressing /, the common convention for
  "search" on the web.

  - Pressing / opens the location search dialog with focus in the search field, exactly as
    the "Add location" action does.
  - The shortcut is ignored while focus is in a text input, a textarea or a
    contenteditable element, and while the search dialog is already open.
  - The shortcut is ignored when Ctrl, Meta or Alt is held.
  - The "Add location" button exposes the shortcut to assistive technology via
    aria-keyshortcuts="/".
  - Unit tests cover the shortcut and each of the ignore cases; one BDD E2E scenario opens
    the search with / and adds a location.

  Out of scope: other shortcuts, a shortcuts help screen, customizable bindings.
